postings.title: Senior Accountant
postings.text:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

 - Maintaining accounting records in accordance with the Polish Accounting Act and the company’s accounting policies (local statutory accounting alongside primary reporting under US GAAP).

 - Working with an external partner to implement and launch a new NetSuite module tailored to Polish regulatory requirements.

 - Reporting issues and errors during and after implementation.

 - Recording and reviewing financial documents (invoices, bank statements and journal entry supporting documents) for accuracy, completeness and compliance with formal requirements.

 - Reconciling account balances, maintaining the fixed asset register, and preparing balance sheets and financial statements.

 - Preparing and reviewing VAT registers and tax returns (JPK_V7, CIT and other mandatory reports).

 - Participating in monthly and annual closes and preparing the company’s financial statements.

 - Liaising with external authorities and preparing documentation, including contact with tax offices, the Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) and Statistics Poland (GUS), as well as supporting audits.

 - Monitoring changes in tax and accounting regulations and implementing the necessary updates to processes and the system.

 - Contributing to improvements in accounting processes.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Owned the full books of a Polish entity under the Accounting Act (preferably 7-10 years)

 - Recent startup or scale-up experience

 - Based in Poland

 - English - at least B2

 - Bonus: NS familiarity




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Poland. If you prefer, you can work from our office in Warsaw. 

 

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

 - A history of consistently exceeding sales targets and achieving strong performance.

 - Expertise in navigating complex sales cycles and developing business champions.

 - Self Starter

 - Analytical skills and proficiency with spreadsheets

 - Proficiency in creating compelling presentations and demos

We're looking for an experienced partnerships leader to build and scale our Commercial Partners Programme in Southern Latam — bringing together resellers, systems integrators, and consulting firms who help deploy ElevenLabs' technology to their clients across the Southern Latam  market.



You'll own the reseller, integrator, and consulting partner strategy end-to-end — from building relationships with leading SIs, consultancies, and resellers, to onboarding, enabling, and activating them to sell and deliver ElevenLabs products.



This is a 0→1 build: you'll design and pilot partner incentive and enablement models, generate qualified pipeline through partner-led opportunities, and scale the programme against regional growth targets, while owning day-to-day execution and partner performance.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6–9 MONTHS)

 - Partner-Sourced & Influenced Revenue: closed-won ARR through GSIs, RSIs, cloud providers, VARs, and technology partners reaching at least 20% of regional revenue

 - Partner-Sourced Pipeline: qualified pipeline created through partners, with a focus on enterprise opportunities in target industries

 - Revenue-Producing Partners: number of partners actively generating pipeline, opportunities, or revenue each quarter

 - Time-to-First Revenue: speed from partner onboarding to first sourced opportunity and first closed-won deal

 - Strategic Account Penetration: new enterprise accounts and executive relationships unlocked through partners that ElevenLabs would've struggled to access directly


REQUIREMENTS

 - 12+ years building and scaling an in-country SaaS/Cloud solution, with a strong network you can leverage from day one

 - 4+ years owning RSI, GSI, and hyperscaler partnerships, with proven experience driving joint account planning, co-sell, and revenue — not just relationship management

 - A builder mindset — experience creating partner motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

 - Comfortable working with technical, API-driven products, and able to explain complex concepts to partners and customers

 - Based in Buenos Aires



Bonus: Mix of 3-4 years in sales + 3-4 years in partnerships/alliances; mix of 3-4 years at a large company + 3-4 years at a smaller/less established company

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


THE ROLE

We're hiring the first dedicated owner of central FP&A at ElevenLabs. You'll own the plan of record: the consolidated company model, the budgeting cycle and the monthly reporting cadence that the CFO, CEO and board use to run the company as we prepare for IPO. Pigment is in place and our data sits in a warehouse with dashboards on top, but the company isn't fully modeled yet. You'll build the core model first, then use it to evaluate every major investment.

 - Build and own the driver-based company model and opex model in Pigment, bringing inputs from commercial, product and compute finance into one model of record.

 - Run the annual budget and quarterly reforecasts end to end, including headcount envelopes and G&A forecasting with budget owners.

 - Set up the monthly cadence of results, budget vs. actuals, functional reviews and quarterly business reviews, and prepare the financial section of the board pack.

 - Bring capital allocation discipline to large decisions on hiring, compute and strategic spend.

You're a builder who still builds the model yourself. You've likely done this at a high-growth tech company where the planning process had to be created while the business scaled, and you care about recommendations that get implemented, not only presented.




REQUIREMENTS

 - You've built a driver-based company model or long-range plan from scratch and used it to drive real decisions.

 - You've run an annual budget and reforecast cycle end to end at a high-growth tech company, and turned the numbers into a clear narrative for executives or the board.

 - Strong commercial judgment: you think in unit economics and gross profit, not only revenue, and your recommendations get implemented.

 - Hands-on with a planning tool (Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive or similar), comfortable with SQL and working off a data warehouse, and you use AI tools every day.

 - Bonus: experience with usage-based or consumption revenue, IPO readiness or public-company FP&A, hands-on Pigment, or building a team.




GROWTH POTENTIAL

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

 - Lead a central FP&A team as it grows toward IPO.

 - Own the planning and guidance process once we are a public company.

 - Take on broader strategic finance scope as the function scales.




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT+0 to GMT+2 timezones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Warsaw and London.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenLabs operates a complex and fast-evolving revenue model – enterprise contracts, self-serve API subscriptions, usage-based billing, and expanding international markets. As a Revenue Accountant, you will play a key role in ElevenLabs’ revenue accounting function. 

You will own significant portions of the monthly revenue close, support the application of ASC 606 to customer arrangements, and help build scalable processes and controls as ElevenLabs grows toward IPO readiness.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Billing Operations, Engineering, and FP&A to support contract review, usage and billing completeness, new product launches, and accurate and timely revenue recognition. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a lean Finance team – the right person will independently run recurring workstreams, identify issues early, and help scale the revenue accounting operating model as the business grows.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Execute significant portions of the monthly revenue close, including journal entries, deferred and unbilled revenue schedules, reconciliations, and flux analysis

 - Perform recurring usage / consumption completeness and billing-to-GL reconciliations; investigate exceptions and drive resolution with cross-functional partners

 - Review customer contracts and apply established ASC 606 guidance to standard arrangements; escalate novel, high-judgment, or precedent-setting matters

 - Support accounting for credits, refunds, contract modifications, cutoff, and variable consideration, with clear and audit-ready documentation

 - Prepare revenue workpapers, audit support, and control evidence; support external audit, walkthroughs, and SOX readiness activities

 - Support accounting readiness and UAT for new products, pricing structures, billing models, and partner / channel launches

 - Improve and automate recurring revenue processes, reconciliations, documentation, and exception reporting as the business scales




REQUIREMENTS

 - Deep expertise in ASC 606, including multi-element arrangements, SSP evaluation, variable consideration, contract modifications, and principal vs. agent analysis

 - Experience leading the revenue close: deferred revenue management, unbilled receivables, journal entry review, and month-end flux analysis

 - Track record of partnering with Sales and Legal on contract review and revenue impact assessments

 - Experience operating in a pre-IPO or public company environment, with direct exposure to external audit, controls build-out, and revenue accounting documentation

 - CPA, ACA, or ACCA qualification (active); Big 4 or public accounting background a strong plus

 - Strong systems proficiency; Stripe, Metronome, HubiFi or a comparable revenue recognition tool preferred




BONUS:

 - Experience with consumption/usage-based and subscription billing models

 - Familiarity with ASC 326 (CECL) and AR accounting in a high-volume SaaS context

 - Multi-entity or international revenue accounting background




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.
